name: haiku
description: H·AI·K·U methodology — universal lifecycle orchestration with hat-based workflows, completion criteria, and automatic context preservation.

interface.shortDescription: Universal lifecycle orchestration for AI-assisted work across 24 domains.
interface.longDescription: H·AI·K·U is a workflow engine that hands an agent one action at a time from a plan kept on disk. Hat-based stages (plan → do → verify), executable completion criteria, drift detection, and a forward-only lifecycle keep long-running work on the rails. Studios cover software, gamedev, hardware, design, product, legal, finance, and more.
